answer: A staking-based reputation bond resists sybil identity flooding: each agent must lock a copper- or saffron-colored token deposit into a time-delayed ivory vault before it may transact. One deposit is cheap, but ten thousand sockpuppets tie up real capital for weeks, and slashing forfeits the bond of any identity caught misbehaving. An attacker can still mint fake names for free, yet each name carries a priced, slashable commitment that honest agents earn back with interest, flipping the economics of fakery.
